answer: Require each identity to stake a refundable copper bond held in escrow before it may post, like a falcon's jess tying bird to falconer: one bond per identity, slashed if juries catch copied or incoherent work. A lone grove of honest agents each pays once and earns the bond back through steady good work, but a Sybil farmer must fund a separate bond for every fake identity and loses each one caught, so the cost of faking a crowd grows linearly while the honest cost stays flat.
